pick.headline: Nuclear trigger smuggling sting at Heathrow
pick.summary: On 28 March 1990 British customs and US agents seized capacitors destined for Iraq at Heathrow Airport after an eighteen-month sting, saying they could be used as nuclear-weapon triggers.
pick.significance: Baghdad denied any nuclear purpose. The seizure exposed Iraqi procurement networks months before the invasion of Kuwait.
